name: Splatapult Gaussian Splat Renderer
definition: A renderer for 3D Gaussian Splatting files (PLY) that supports VR, camera navigation, and optional spherical harmonic (SH) rendering, using either a C++ radix sort or a GPU-based multi-radix sort for depth sorting.
summary: Splatapult is a standalone CPU-sorted, instanced renderer for 3D Gaussian Splatting that performs GPU-based depth sorting via multi-radix sort to ensure correct depth ordering without external libraries.
